resources.string: Allows TV Home to read on-screen text from the current app for personal-use screen content access. Enable only if you trust this sideloaded launcher.
No readable text from the current window. Open another app, then return here and try again — or enable Accessibility if it is off.
Accessibility is off. Open Settings to enable “TV Home Screen Reader”, then use Read screen.
No launchable apps found. Press Refresh after installing apps.
No user apps to show. Select “Show system apps: OFF” to turn it ON — most TV apps are marked as system apps.
